title: Gray+purple theme tokens and MGP ID validation before checkout navigation

requirements.summary: Replace the current black/blue liquid-glass palette with a cohesive gray-forward theme with purple primary/accent via token updates so existing token-based classes update automatically across the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary/accent colors throughout the app render as purple hues, with backgrounds/cards/borders in gray tones (no blue-forward palette).

Existing token-based classes (e.g., bg-background, bg-card, text-foreground, border-border, text-primary, bg-primary) automatically reflect the new gray+purple theme without needing per-component color overrides.
The DiamondIcon (♦) continues to use token-based coloring (e.g., text-primary) and appears consistent with the updated gray+purple theme on Home, Gen 4 options, and Gen 5 options.

file_operations.description: Update the CSS variable design tokens for light/dark modes to a gray + purple palette (background/surface/border/text neutrals; primary/accent purple hues) so existing token-based Tailwind classes reflect the new theme everywhere.
Align the root-level Tailwind CSS variable tokens with the same gray + purple palette as the app (keep variables consistent across build entrypoints).
Adjust any liquid-glass specific styling values that are blue-forward (e.g., glass shadow rgba) to neutral/gray-forward with subtle purple tint so the overall theme no longer reads blue.

Replace hard-coded green success styling with token-based classes (e.g., primary/accent/muted) so order confirmation visuals remain cohesive with the gray+purple theme without introducing non-token color islands. (Uses existing shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)

requirements.summary: Validate MGP ID format in both Gen 4 Racer and Gen 5 Racer dialogs: must be exactly 'mgp-' followed by one or more digits, with English validation feedback and blocked confirmation when invalid.
acceptanceCriteria: In both Gen 4 Racer and Gen 5 Racer dialogs, an MGP ID is considered valid only if it matches the pattern: mgp- followed by one or more digits (e.g., mgp-1, mgp-12345).
Inputs that do not match the pattern (e.g., empty, missing prefix, mgp- with no digits, mgp-12a, MGP-123) are treated as invalid and cannot be confirmed/submitted.
User-facing validation feedback is shown in English when the entered value is invalid (wording can be simple, e.g., "MGP ID must start with 'mgp-' followed by digits only.").

file_operations.description: Add a small shared utility for MGP ID validation (e.g., a function that checks /^mgp-\d+$/) so both dialogs enforce the exact same rules.

Update the Gen 4 Racer MGP dialog input handling to use the shared MGP validator, show an English inline error message when invalid, and disable/ignore Confirm (including Enter key submit) unless the value matches 'mgp-' + digits only. (Uses existing shadcn-ui Dialog/Input/Button/Label; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)

Update the Gen 5 Racer pre-order dialog input handling to use the shared MGP validator, show an English inline error message when invalid, and disable/ignore Confirm (including Enter key submit) unless the value matches 'mgp-' + digits only. (Uses existing shadcn-ui Dialog/Input/Button/Label; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)

requirements.summary: On valid MGP ID confirmation, immediately navigate to the existing /checkout page with correct router search params and remove the prior in-dialog success end state; do not navigate on invalid input.
acceptanceCriteria: On Gen 4 Racer: confirming a valid MGP ID navigates to /checkout with search params that include model="Gen 4 Racer" (and sets an appropriate 'from' value so the checkout back button returns to Gen 4 options).
On Gen 5 Racer: confirming a valid MGP ID navigates to /checkout with search params that include model="Gen 5 Racer" and from="gen5" so the checkout back button returns to Gen 5 options.
The prior in-dialog success state (e.g., "Mgp ID Accepted") is no longer shown as the end state; navigation to checkout occurs immediately upon successful confirm.
If the MGP ID is invalid, the app stays in the dialog and does not navigate.

file_operations.description: Remove the Gen 4 Racer dialog success panel state and change the confirm handler to (1) validate via the shared MGP validator and (2) navigate directly to /checkout with search params including model:"Gen 4 Racer" and a 'from' value that routes back to Gen 4 options (e.g., from:"gen4-elc"). Keep dialog open/no navigation on invalid. (Uses existing shadcn-ui Dialog/Input/Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)

Remove the Gen 5 Racer dialog success panel state and change the confirm handler to (1) validate via the shared MGP validator and (2) navigate directly to /checkout with search params including model:"Gen 5 Racer" and from:"gen5". Keep dialog open/no navigation on invalid. (Uses existing shadcn-ui Dialog/Input/Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)

Confirm checkout continues to read the router search params (model/from) so the header shows the correct model and the back button returns to the correct options page for both Gen 4 Racer (from gen4 options) and Gen 5 Racer (from gen5). (Uses existing shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)
